$comment: Generated by 04_BUILD/companion_pack.py in the book project.
Every figure comes from book.json, the 01_SOURCE indexes and the built paperback; nothing here is edited by hand.
No answer and no seal word is printed in any file.

files.title: Quest log
files.description: The whole route on a few sheets: every page in book order with its mission line, its page number and a box to tick, the star-box pages marked, and a ring to draw each region's seal into. Pin it up and mark it off.

files.title: Culture cards
files.description: Twenty-two cut-out cards, one for each people the route meets, in route order: name, region, whether the tradition is living today, and which pages in the book are theirs.

files.title: Spare certificate
files.description: A clean copy of the Field Researcher certificate from the back of the book, with the six seal rings — for a second reader sharing the book, or a second run through it.
